single_mode_identification.note: single trapped mode: the deviation from the predicted constant is exactly the far-field Hankel error of the normalised route, i.e. eps is identified, not just bounded

rigid_limit.note: deviation * rho_bottom is constant to a few parts in 1e3 over six decades of rho_bottom, so the solver reproduces the closed-form rigid-wall roots at first order in rho_w/rho_b

physical_plate.why_not_applicable: the normalised route assumes the pressure-release top; with a plate the operator is not self-adjoint and the density-normalised sum is the wrong reference, so only the vanishing-plate limit is graded against it

C1_identity_grid.bound_note: max_m hankel_asymptotic_error_db is a per-mode scale, not a strict bound on the multi-mode sum: the modal errors carry independent phases and can add. The residual exceeds that scale by at most 6.14e-04 dB here, and coincides with it exactly in the single-mode regime (criterion C2).
